title: Estonian Government Scholarships for Degree Students
field: All fields (priority to STEM, ICT and fields aligned with Estonia's R&D strategy)
description: State scholarships supporting international master's and doctoral students enrolled at Estonian public universities, usually combined with a tuition fee waiver from the host university.
amount: Monthly stipend of EUR 350 (master's) to EUR 660 (doctoral), typically alongside a tuition waiver

title: University of Tartu Tuition Waiver Scholarships
description: Merit-based tuition waivers for international students admitted to an English-taught master's programme at Estonia's leading research university, with a limited number of stipends also available.
amount: Full or partial tuition fee waiver; selected awards add a monthly stipend

title: TalTech Scholarships for International Students
field: Engineering, IT, business, science, maritime studies
description: Tuition waivers and monthly stipends for high-achieving international students admitted to an English-taught master's programme at Estonia's largest technical university.
amount: Full or partial tuition fee waiver; some awards add a stipend of around EUR 350 per month

title: IT Academy Scholarships
provider: Education and Youth Board of Estonia (IT Academy programme)
description: Scholarships for master's students in ICT curricula at Estonian universities participating in the IT Academy programme, funded to strengthen Estonia's technology sector.
amount: Monthly stipend of around EUR 400, often alongside a tuition waiver

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Estonia-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, some coordinated by or including Estonian institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
